newsitem.title: UK: Bank of England changes gilt auction bid deadline.
newsitem.headline: Bank of England changes gilt auction bid deadline.

text.p: The Bank of England said on Tuesday it had moved the deadline for bids for its March gilt auction and all future gilt auctions to 1030 local time from 1000.

The Bank said the change followed reforms of its sterling money market operations and was aimed at avoiding a possible clash between the auction and the Bank's round of open market operations in the money markets at 0945 local time.
Earlier on Tuesday the Bank said it would auction 2.5 billion stg of 7.25 percent gilts on March 26.
